summary: Executed backend+frontend retest for vehicle quick print menu on preview. Backend print generation and auth core checks passed, but frontend header diagnosis/quote print remained unstable after invoice flow in same session (QuickPrintDialog not opening). No failed /api/documents/generate observed during UI runs.

minor.issue: CORS credentials header missing on actual login response for production origin in auth preview regression (access-control-allow-credentials expected true).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful invoice preview/close, selecting diagnosis (and then quote) intermittently does not open QuickPrintDialog (timeout waiting for dialog).

integration_issues.flow: Vehicle header print menu -> diagnosis/quote preview
integration_issues.issue: Invoice preview is stable, but diagnosis failed 3 attempts total across reruns and quote also failed in same sequence. Indicates menu-close/open dialog sequencing race persists.
Could not fully validate print/download-pdf/whatsapp action stability for diagnosis/quote because those dialogs did not open in failing runs.

action_items: Fix VehicleDetails header print flow race where diagnosis/quote does not reopen QuickPrintDialog after invoice close.
Retest uninterrupted sequence: invoice -> diagnosis -> quote -> visit print -> print/download/whatsapp actions.
Fix CORS credentials header behavior for /api/auth/login actual response under production origin preflight path.
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleDetails.jsx (~4.6k lines) has high UI-state coupling; print menu state and dialog state transitions are prone to regression.
openHeaderPrintDialog currently relies on setPrintMenuOpen(false) + requestAnimationFrame(openQuickPrintDialog), which is likely insufficiently deterministic under rapid re-open cycles.
QuickPrintDialog itself generated invoice/visit previews correctly when opened; failure is at trigger orchestration layer rather than /api/documents/generate response generation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated login with مدير/123123 and target route /vehicle/ffcf800c-d1bb-40df-8df3-effa59bc05cd. Confirmed exactly one header menu button and no standalone diagnosis button. Invoice and first visit preview succeeded with workshop fields. Diagnosis/quote dialog open failed repeatedly after invoice close (3+ attempts), so stop selector retries and continue from race-condition debugging.
rca of the issue: Repro: login -> open /vehicle/:id -> open menu -> invoice opens and closes correctly -> reopen menu -> click diagnosis (or quote) -> QuickPrintDialog sometimes never appears within 20s. Network listener saw no failed /api/documents/generate in these failing attempts, suggesting request may not be fired due to front-end state sequencing. Likely root cause is timing/race between printMenuOpen state teardown and print dialog open trigger (requestAnimationFrame + event propagation cycle). Mitigation: make open sequence deterministic (e.g., close menu and wait until overlay unmounted before opening dialog; guard against stale click events; add explicit state transition callback/queue).
